name: Seeking Health
description: Supplement brand selling practitioner-formulated vitamins and supplements, running Affiliate and Ambassador partner programs for health practitioners, certified health coaches and influencers.

evidence.summary: Seeking Health's official affiliate page headlines 'earn unlimited commissions' and a section titled 'Uncapped Commissions', stating rates start at 15% and affiliates can earn up to 20% and more, with a 60-day cookie window, free product samples and a monthly personalized 10%-off coupon code for followers. The starting rate of 15% is recorded; the cap is verified uncapped on the brand's own wording.

The same official page publishes affiliate@seekinghealth.com twice in its FAQ for program-fit and general affiliate questions, and describes a four-step join process (choose Affiliate or Ambassador, apply, get approved, start earning) with payment within the first two weeks of each month.

reasons.niche_fit: Practitioner-grade supplements are a core health-creator niche, and the program explicitly recruits influencers as well as practitioners and coaches.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A public partner page recruiting influencers, with free product for campaign promotion, though no creator counts were published on fetched pages.
reasons.compensation: Verified uncapped commissions starting at 15% and rising to 20% and more - among the strongest supplement terms found.
reasons.contact_access: Published affiliate@seekinghealth.com program email on the official page.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Application with brand approval; two tracks (Affiliate or Ambassador).
reasons.credibility: Established supplement brand with a structured partner program and educational institute offering; founding details were not on the fetched page, so held at 4.

name: IM8 Health
description: Daily all-in-one nutrition powder brand co-founded with David Beckham, selling an NSF-certified daily essentials formula positioned to replace a stack of separate supplements, by subscription.

evidence.summary: IM8's official Ambassador Program page states ambassadors earn 10% commission on every new customer order through their link or code and says verbatim 'No caps on your earnings - ever'; its FAQ answers 'How much can I earn as an IM8 Ambassador?' with 'There's no limit on your earnings - the more you refer, the more you earn.' Applications run through Social Snowball, payouts are monthly via PayPal or bank transfer after a 30-day hold, with a $100 minimum payout balance. The cap is verified uncapped on the brand's own page.
The same page publishes affiliates@im8health.com as the dedicated ambassador support contact, states the program is open internationally, and describes personal review of every application.

The official page describes IM8 as daily nutrition backed by science, certified by NSF, and co-founded with David Beckham, with ambassadors receiving free products, merch and early access to new flavour drops.

reasons.niche_fit: An all-in-one daily nutrition powder is a highly demo-able staple of wellness and routine content.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A structured ambassador program with dashboard, codes, free product and event perks; no Beacons creator count was verified on fetched pages, so saturation stays unknown.
reasons.compensation: 10% per new order is mid-range, but the earnings cap is verified uncapped in the brand's own words.
reasons.credibility: NSF-certified product, co-founded with David Beckham and built by a listed health company, per the brand's own pages and coverage.

name: Gundry MD
description: Supplement and lectin-free food brand founded by Dr. Steven Gundry, selling gut-health, probiotic and polyphenol formulas and Plant Paradox program products through its own store and national retail.

evidence.summary: Gundry MD's official Ambassador Program page publishes a 20% commission on all referral sales through a personalized ambassador link, and its FAQ states verbatim: 'There's no limit on the amount of referrals you can make or the commission you can earn.' Joining is free, payments are issued monthly, and ambassadors join an online community with campaign access. The cap is verified uncapped on the brand's own page.

Beacons Universe reports posts from only 11 creators all time for Gundry MD, with 1 public post in the last 12 months and no sponsored posts in that period, and lists the brand as based in Beverly Hills, United States - a very small absolute creator footprint for a national brand, so creator saturation is recorded as low.

reasons.niche_fit: Gut health, probiotics and lectin-free eating are proven, content-rich health niches with a large book and video audience behind the founder.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Only 11 creators all time on Beacons - a genuinely open field, though it also means little documented creator campaign volume.
reasons.compensation: 20% on all referral sales with a verified no-limit statement on the official page.
reasons.contact_access: No usable program email was published in readable form on the fetched page; joining runs through the ambassador sign-up form.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Free, open sign-up form on the brand's ambassador page.
reasons.credibility: National supplement brand with retail distribution and a long-running founder-led media presence.

name: Listen to Your Gut
description: Gut-health brand founded by Jini Patel Thompson, selling natural remedies, Absorb Plus elemental shakes, Imix Nutrition supplements and books through the LTYG Shoppe for people with digestive conditions.

evidence.summary: Listen to Your Gut's official affiliates page publishes a 20% commission on qualifying products and lists among its Program Benefits, verbatim: 'There is NO cap on your earnings.' Commissions are paid quarterly by check or PayPal once the balance exceeds $99, and sign-up runs through Affiliatly with applications typically approved within 24 hours on weekdays. The cap is verified uncapped on the brand's own page; note the page carries a 2022 posting date, so terms should be re-confirmed at sign-up.
The same official page publishes affiliates@listentoyourgut.com for affiliate questions and names founder Jini Patel Thompson, describing products as tried and tested by her and thousands of readers.

opportunity.title: Listen to Your Gut Affiliate Program (Affiliatly)

reasons.niche_fit: Natural gut-health remedies and elemental shakes serve a dedicated IBD/IBS creator niche - deep but narrower than mainstream supplements.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A long-running affiliate page welcoming websites and newsletters; no creator counts were published on fetched pages.
reasons.compensation: 20% commission with a verified 'NO cap on your earnings' statement on the official page.
reasons.contact_access: Published affiliates@listentoyourgut.com email on the official page.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open Affiliatly sign-up with fast stated approval times.
reasons.credibility: Long-established founder-led gut-health brand; the affiliate page is dated 2022, so held at 4 pending re-confirmation of terms.

name: Adya Water

name: Lysera
description: Supplement brand built on transparency - fully disclosed labels with no proprietary blends, third-party testing for purity, potency and heavy metals, and direct fair pricing.

evidence.summary: Lysera's official affiliate page publishes a 25% commission on every sale, stating 'No tiers, no caps, no fine print', and its FAQ answers 'How much can I earn?' with 'You earn 25% of every sale your link drives, with no cap.' The program runs on Rewardful with a real-time dashboard, pays via PayPal or Wise, has no follower minimum and no contracts or quotas, and ships a free product after an affiliate's first post. The cap is verified uncapped on the brand's own page.

reasons.niche_fit: Transparent-label supplements fit supplement-review and wellness creator content well.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A creator-friendly program design (free product after first post, no quotas), though no creator counts were published on fetched pages.
reasons.compensation: 25% flat on every order with a verified no-cap statement - top-tier supplement terms.
reasons.contact_access: No published program email was found; joining runs through the affiliate page's Rewardful sign-up.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Sign-up in under two minutes with no follower minimum, per the official page.
reasons.credibility: Third-party testing and full label disclosure are documented on the brand's own pages; a younger brand, so held at 4.

name: Dr. Westin Childs
description: Online store for thyroid supplements and red light devices formulated for people with hypothyroidism, Hashimoto's, hyperthyroidism and life after thyroidectomy or RAI, sold through Restart Med with free US shipping and a 120-day money-back guarantee.

evidence.summary: The official Dr. Westin Childs affiliate FAQ on restartmed.com publishes a 10% commission on the entire purchase price for orders placed within 30 days of a link click (also credited via a unique $10-off coupon code), lists 'No cap on commissions earned' in its program overview, and answers 'How much can I earn?' with 'There is no cap on how much you can earn!' Payouts are monthly via PayPal with no minimum, or store credit. The cap is verified uncapped on the brand's own page.
The same official page publishes hello@restartmed.com and a Mesa, Arizona address in its additional details, and describes the store as formulated for thyroid patients.

reasons.niche_fit: Thyroid-specific supplements serve a focused, high-intent health niche with strong personal-story content.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A public affiliate FAQ explicitly welcoming followers and social sharing; no creator counts were published on fetched pages.
reasons.compensation: 10% per order is modest, but the no-cap statement is verified twice on the official page and there is no payout minimum.
reasons.contact_access: Published hello@restartmed.com general email on the program page.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Application reviewed by the brand's team, per the official FAQ.
reasons.credibility: Physician-led thyroid brand with a physical US address and money-back guarantee published on the page.

reasons.niche_fit: Practitioner-grade peptides and nutraceuticals fit biohacking and performance-wellness creator content.
reasons.ugc_evidence: The program explicitly recruits wellness content creators alongside practitioners and biohackers; no creator counts were published on fetched pages.

reasons.contact_access: No published program email was found on the fetched page; contact runs through the affiliate account.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Free to join, earning starts once the application is approved.
reasons.credibility: Practitioner-designed, lab-tested positioning with published batch results, per the brand's own page.

name: Active Green Pro

evidence.summary: Active Green Pro's official collaborators page FAQ answers 'Is there a limit to how much I can earn?' with 'No, there is no limit to your earnings. The more you promote, the more you can earn.' The same page CONFLICTS on the rate: its perks list states a 5% commission on every sale while its FAQ states a 10% commission on the selling price of every bottle, so commission_rate is recorded as null with the conflict flagged for confirmation inside Shopify Collabs. Applications run through Shopify Collabs and the program is open to influencers, bloggers and content creators.

reasons.niche_fit: Green superfood powders are a staple of morning-routine and wellness creator content.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A public collaborators page with gift kits and marketing materials for creators; no creator counts were published on fetched pages.
reasons.compensation: Earnings limit is verified uncapped in the official FAQ, but the page's own 5% vs 10% rate conflict is unresolved, so compensation is scored low until confirmed in Collabs.
reasons.contact_access: Published info@activegreenpro.com contact on the official page.
reasons.credibility: Small brand with an internal rate inconsistency on its own program page, so credibility held at 3.
